_help: Regulators, credential bodies, credential types and credential relationship rules for professional and supervisor verification. Read by worker/verification/*.js and worker/professional.js. adapter: the verification adapter id in worker/verification/adapters.js. 'manual' means Wavelength has no authorised automated source yet (none exists, or one exists but Wavelength has not been granted access and confirmed its terms), so the claim goes to the admin panel (status manual_verification_required). officialApi records an official API the body offers; its status stays 'not_authorised' until Wavelength holds credentials and written terms. Never change an adapter to a live one without a written agreement or licence from the body, and update 'access' and 'checked' when you do. See docs/verification-architecture.md.

regulators.name: General Medical Council
regulators.access: Public online search (website terms allow non-commercial reuse only). Licensed Medical Register download: about £815 a year plus VAT, daily full or change files, signed agreement, permitted purpose 'validating the registration status of medical practitioners'; republication needs a separate licence. No physician associate or anaesthesia associate download. GMC Connect is for designated bodies, not vendors. No public API.
regulators.future: dataset: licensed Medical Register download (doctors). Ask data@gmc-uk.org.

regulators.name: Nursing and Midwifery Council
regulators.access: Public search by PIN. Employer Confirmation Service needs an NMC username and password and checks up to 10 PINs at once. No API, data licence or download found.
regulators.future: Ask the NMC whether a verification service is available to a registered third party with consent.

regulators.name: Health and Care Professions Council
regulators.numberHint: two letters and up to six digits, for example PA123456
regulators.access: Free public check, updated in real time. Multiple Registrant Search checks up to 100 numbers at once. The HCPC also offers an official Employer Check API (see officialApi). Wavelength has no access yet, so checks stay manual.

officialApi.name: HCPC Employer Check API
officialApi.purpose: Request HCPC registrant data directly into your own application, as described in the HCPC's employer guidance.
officialApi.dataScope: Only data already public on the HCPC online register: no contact details or other personal identifiers.
officialApi.accessRequirements: To confirm with the HCPC: eligibility of a non-employer verification provider, credentials, authentication, fees, rate limits, terms of use and permitted purposes.
officialApi.confidence: High that the API exists (HCPC employer guidance). Access terms unconfirmed: the page could not be read in full from the build environment.

regulators.future: api: an 'hcpc-employer-check' adapter on the Employer Check API, built only after the HCPC grants Wavelength access and its terms are confirmed in writing. Until then: manual checks of the public register (or Multiple Registrant Search where permitted).

regulators.name: General Pharmaceutical Council
regulators.access: Data subscription service for organisations: about £600 a year, daily XML or CSV, licence purpose 'validating the registration status'. A web service may be offered (unconfirmed).
regulators.future: dataset or api under the GPhC data subscription licence.

regulators.name: Medical Council (Ireland)
regulators.access: Public live register. No API or download found.

regulators.name: Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland
BIG-register (Netherlands)
regulators.access: Public SOAP web service run by CIBG for the Ministry of Health (api.bigregister.nl), documented for searching from your own system. Fees and terms to confirm.
regulators.future: api: the clearest European candidate for a live adapter once terms are confirmed in writing.

regulators.name: Register of Clinical Technologists
regulators.numberHint: as shown on your RCT certificate
regulators.access: Accredited register (PSA), public directory. Took over the Public Voluntary Register of Sonographers in 2021. No API found.

credentialTypes.label: FAMUS supervisor
credentialTypes.source: SAM FAMUS directory of supervisors: name, position, trust or hospital, date of registration and email, published with the supervisor's consent; module shown per row. No registration number, no expiry, no API. Peripheral vascular access is not a SAM-registered supervisor module: SAM says supervision for it is determined locally.
credentialTypes.access: Manual check of the public page by an administrator. Automated matching needs SAM's written permission.

directory.name: SAM FAMUS directory of supervisors
directory.consent: SAM publishes a supervisor's name, position, trust or hospital, date of registration and email in the directory only if the supervisor consents.
directory.permission: Individual lookups by an administrator, by hand. No scraping, bulk copying, automated synchronisation or republication. A data-sharing or verification arrangement needs SAM's written agreement.

credentialTypes.label: FAMUS mentor (locally determined)
credentialTypes.source: SAM does not register FAMUS mentors. The FAMUS curriculum pack says a mentor must be competent in the scan they oversee, can be any grade, and that suitability is determined locally. Mentors review images from mentored scans and cannot sign the Assessment of Completion of Training.
credentialTypes.access: Evidence only: confirmation from the trainee's FAMUS supervisor or the departmental ultrasound lead, or another credential showing competence in the scan (for example FAMUS accreditation).

credentialTypes.label: FUSIC Heart supervisor
credentialTypes.source: ICS FUSIC TMS directory, category 'Supervisor FUSIC Heart', searched by hospital: name, hospital and sometimes an email. Eligibility (ICS): BSE Level 2 TTE accreditation, EDEC, FUSIC HD trainer, or a cardiologist with regular TTE sessions; ICS reviews each application. Supervisors conduct the triggered assessment and countersign the summary training record.
credentialTypes.access: Manual check of the public directory by an administrator. Automated matching needs ICS permission.

directory.name: ICS FUSIC TMS directory
directory.consent: Not stated on the directory page.
directory.permission: Individual lookups by an administrator, by hand. No scraping, bulk copying, automated synchronisation or republication without ICS's written agreement.

credentialTypes.label: FUSIC Heart mentor
credentialTypes.source: ICS FUSIC TMS directory, category 'Mentor FUSIC Heart'. ICS approves mentors on application; a mentor needs an identified supervisor, assesses logbooks and is involved in the triggered assessment with the supervisor. A mentor is not the final signatory.
credentialTypes.access: Manual check of the public directory by an administrator.

directory.name: ICS FUSIC TMS directory

credentialTypes.source: ICS FUSIC TMS directory, category 'Supervisor fTOE'. For fTOE there are only supervisors, who act as both mentor and supervisor. The Wavelength logbook has no fTOE module yet, so this credential is recorded but supports no approval scope.
credentialTypes.access: Manual check of the public directory by an administrator.

directory.name: ICS FUSIC TMS directory

credentialTypes.label: CACTUS trainer
credentialTypes.source: ICS FUSIC TMS directory categories 'Trainer CACTUS Lung' and 'Trainer CACTUS Cardiac'. CACTUS module rules have not been read from a primary source yet, so this credential supports no approval scope.
credentialTypes.access: Manual check of the public directory by an administrator.

directory.name: ICS FUSIC TMS directory
directory.consent: Not stated on the directory page.

credentialTypes.label: FUSIC trainer
credentialTypes.source: ICS FUSIC TMS directory: trainers per module (categories such as 'Trainer FUSIC Lung', 'Trainer FUSIC Abdomen', 'FUSIC Vascular trainer', 'Trainer FUSIC DVT', 'Trainer FUSIC HD'). A trainer is recognised for the module named only, after at least 12 months' accreditation in it; trainers review logbook scans, sign competencies and conduct the triggered assessment.
credentialTypes.access: Manual check of the public directory by an administrator.

credentialTypes.label: FUSIC accredited
credentialTypes.source: No public list of accredited practitioners: certificates are emailed by the ICS.

credentialTypes.label: FAMUS accredited
credentialTypes.source: Accredited practitioners are not published by SAM.

credentialTypes.label: BSE accreditation
credentialTypes.source: BSE accredited members list: full name, accreditation type and 'accredited until' date. No hospital or registration number. BSE accreditation is a qualification: it does not by itself make anyone a FUSIC, FAMUS or EDEC supervisor (each programme approves its own).
credentialTypes.access: Manual check with expiry date. Ask BSE before any automated lookup.

directory.name: BSE list of accredited members
directory.permission: Individual lookups by an administrator, by hand. Ask BSE before any automated lookup or republication.

credentialTypes.label: EACVI certification
credentialTypes.source: ESC list of certified healthcare professionals in imaging: first name, last name, country, certification expiry. Certification needs the examination and the logbook; passing the examination alone is not certification. Certification is not a supervisor appointment.
credentialTypes.access: ESC terms forbid substantive extraction or automated collection. Individual manual lookups only.

directory.name: ESC list of certified healthcare professionals in imaging
directory.permission: ESC terms forbid substantive extraction or automated collection: individual manual lookups only.

credentialTypes.label: European Diploma in Advanced Critical Care Echocardiography
credentialTypes.source: No public list of diploma holders found.

credentialTypes.label: EDEC approved supervisor
credentialTypes.source: EDEC Guidelines 2025 (ESICM, updated 13 November 2025), section 2.2: the supervisor must be approved by the EDEC Committee and hold full TTE or TOE accreditation from a recognised body (Appendix A lists examples, not exhaustively); the supervisor may be remote, validates the logbook in the EDEC ePortfolio and signs the supervisor declaration (Appendix B); a mentor cannot substitute for the supervisor. Holding an Appendix A accreditation makes someone eligible to apply, not appointed. ESICM publishes certified supervisors by region, but a list may lag behind appointments and ends, so a listing alone is never relied on.
credentialTypes.access: Evidence only: written confirmation of appointment from ESICM (education@esicm.org), checked against the current EDEC guidelines. The Wavelength logbook has no EDEC pathway, so this credential supports no approval scope.

credentialTypes.label: RCEM ultrasound supervisor (local role)
credentialTypes.source: RCEM publishes no register of ultrasound supervisors. Supervision is a local role (senior decision maker, departmental PoCUS lead), evidenced in risr/advance.
credentialTypes.access: Evidence only: a letter or email from the departmental PoCUS lead, clinical director or educational supervisor, from an NHS or institutional address.

credentialTypes.label: Advanced practice (Centre for Advancing Practice)
credentialTypes.source: Centre for Advancing Practice directory and digital badge. No API found.

credentialTypes.label: Local ultrasound credentialing or supervisor role
credentialTypes.source: No register: a role or credential granted by the applicant's own organisation.
credentialTypes.access: Evidence only: a letter or email from the departmental ultrasound lead, clinical director or educational supervisor, or the applicant's written explanation.

credentialTypes.label: Other ultrasound qualification, course or instructor role
credentialTypes.source: Varies: the applicant names the qualification or course and who awarded it.
credentialTypes.access: Evidence (a certificate) or the applicant's written explanation.

_help_rules: Credential relationships. Each rule: { id, from: credential type id (and optional modules), relation: 'may_satisfy_prerequisite', to: role or credential id the body defines, source: URL of the body's own rule, quote: the sentence relied on, checked: date, status: 'draft' or 'active' }. Only 'active' rules with a source are used. Leave empty until a body's published rule has been read and recorded.
